headlines.title: Bay Area storm updates: Crews clean up as showers linger
headlines.description: Six people in San Francisco were taken to the hospital Thursday morning following a multi-vehicle crash in which one car slammed into a building, according to the fire department. The crash happened just before 10 a.m. in the area of Fell and Pierce streets, not far from Alamo Square Park, the fire department said. The conditions of the six people were not immediately known. The city’s Department of Building Inspection was called to the scene to assess the damage to the building that was hit, the fire department said. An investigation is underway. headlines.source: Joel Soria, Brendan Weber and Kristofer Noceda
